visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Index Confused with the Letter
visualizerParams.problemDescription: In leetcode the first unique letter l is at index 0, but the program prints 2.

solution.explanation: counts is indexed by letter (0 for a, 1 for b, ...), not by position in the text. counts[i] asks about the i-th letter of the alphabet, so the loop finds the first letter of the alphabet that occurs once (c, index 2).
